hypotheses.W0_write_alignment_is_adjudicative: For at least one of Layers 1-3, leave-one-relation-out MLP-write alignment R2 is >=0.30 in every ordered initialization pair and omitted relation.
hypotheses.W1_semantic_write_is_initialization_inva: At an adjudicative Layer 1 or 2, mapped same-rule writes have fidelity >=0.50 and accuracy no more than 0.15 below the target model's own semantic edit.
hypotheses.W2_same_rule_write_beats_wrong_rule: At an adjudicative Layer 1 or 2, same-rule writes beat norm-matched wrong-rule writes by >=0.20 fidelity or >=0.15 target accuracy.
hypotheses.W3_write_space_is_more_canonical_than_ch: At an adjudicative layer, mean held-out write R2 exceeds the prior raw-activation R2 by >=0.30.
hypotheses.W4_final_write_matches_target_answer_int: At adjudicative Layer 3, target generic-answer fidelity is within 0.10 of mapped semantic fidelity and both are >=0.70.
hypotheses.W5_activation_inverse_is_exact: Maximum relative error when realizing a mapped target write through target MLP channels is <=1e-5.
